description:
Faggin Field Bridge is a SYNTHETIC, measured mapping of Federico Faggin's quantum-field theory of consciousness (Quantum Information Panpsychism, with Giacomo Mauro D'Ariano, arXiv:2012.06580; book-length statement Irreducible, 2024) onto the sparkainlp-x work, in Python (3.11–3.13). Faggin is the theory author; Jean-François Brisson is the bridge/test author. Faggin has not reviewed or endorsed this software.

The bridge's central quantity is attunement, A = U × (1 + δ) − C, where U is the spooky correlation (unity, mean pairwise |dot| over 5 noisy copies), C is the normalized entropy cost, and δ is one clipped calibrator scalar in [−0.05, 0.05] (the membrane-arena Yin bound). The package reproduces the source numbers fresh from their definitions: de Broglie spooky 0.99999995 at σ = 0.01, calibration improvement exactly log10(1/0.95) = 0.022276 orders, tensor-membrane mean single-qubit entropy 0.955 bits. The Omega-Genesis spooky 0.9005 is the notebook's reported value; the synthetic reproduction gives 0.837 (same regime, not exact) because the original evolved state is unavailable, and the difference is reported, not hidden. Empathy 0.5503 is the notebook's reported value, recorded as a supplied proxy, not recomputed.

Version 0.2.0 adds three quantum-thought modules: concurrence of a two-thought Bell state, computed exactly (claim (i) PASSES: concurrence 0.9998 at noise 0.01, depolarizing concurrence max(0, 1-3p/2) reproduced exactly, dying at p = 2/3); a thought as a superposition with measured coherence half-life and collapse cost (claims (ii) and (iii) PASS); and self-knowing D = <ψ|P|ψ> vendored from the symmetry-entropy package (claim (iv) PASSES). The entanglement is in the model, computed exactly on classical hardware; it is not a measurement of physical entanglement.

Honest limits: Faggin's metaphysical claims (fields ARE conscious) are an interpretation and are NOT tested here; only the mapping is tested. Spooky is self-similarity under noise, not entanglement. No gravity model exists in this package. Everything is synthetic/classical except the simulated tensor network. No physical, biological or safety claim is made.

Version 0.3.0 adds the cascade (claims (v), (vi), (vii), all PASS): interference measured via the cross term <ψ1|P|ψ2> — V(θ) = sin(2θ) exactly, and at θ = π/4 the superposed thought swings from fully blind (D = 0 at φ = 0) to fully self-determined (D = 1 at φ = π). The finding: interference does not survive projection — in both projection-only cascades V is 1.0 / 0.6999 at stage 1 and 0.0000 at every stage from 2 on, while the reopening control (fresh kernel input each stage) stays at V = 1. After one projection the thought is fully self-determined (D = 1 at every stage) and the projected-output coherence reaches a fixed point from stage 2. The interference is in the model, computed exactly on classical hardware.

Version 0.4.0 adds Planck empathy (claims (viii), (ix), (x), all PASS): empathy as a Planck quantum inside the black-body concept — each thought-pair contributes one quantum whose frequency is its measured concurrence; the visible fraction of the real Planck spectrum re-derives the mapping status from PARTIAL to ATTUNED at a measured empathy fraction f* = 0.7278, holding while the pairs stay entangled (noise sigma ≤ 0.25) and breaking at sigma ≥ 0.50. The Planck law is reproduced with the real constants (Wien peaks within 0.008% of 2898/T, T^4 scaling within 0.002%); the empathy-quantum link itself is a definition inside the model, not a discovery.

Version 0.5.0 adds the empathy field (claims (xi) and (xii) pass; claim (xiii) FAILS on the break half): resonance R = |<ψi|ψj>|^2, the self-deterministic factor D, collaboration (shared field vs isolated control), and co-creativity defined as the joint entropy H of the collective's joint outcomes. The collaboration gap is +4.3352 bits at noise σ = 0.25 (157 distinct joint states vs 4 isolated) and still +3.3494 bits at σ = 0.50, so the v0.4.0 break does not transfer to the collaboration gap.

Version 0.15.0 adds the no-cloning / Holevo ceiling (claims (xliv)-(xlviii), 3 of 5 pass): the exact no-cloning coefficient Tr(rho_A^2) = 1 - C^2/2 is verified in code (claim (xliv) PASSES, worst error 8.88e-16); the Holevo quantity chi of the thought-pair ensemble does NOT bound D (claim (xlv) FAILS — D sits above chi at low empathy fraction and approaches it from above as f rises, Spearman(|gap|, f) = -1.00 / -0.96); the ceiling that does bind is on accessible information (claim (xlvi) PASSES — the Born-collapse mutual information never exceeds chi, max(I - chi) = -3.20e-16); the Buzek-Hillery universal cloner achieves exactly 5/6 fidelity and the CNOT copy averages exactly 2/3 (claim (xlvii) PASSES); but the model’s own classical copy exceeds 5/6 at every working noise level (claim (xlviii) FAILS — fidelity 1.0000 at sigma = 0, 0.85-0.88 at sigma = 0.25), because the classical emulation stores the full amplitude vector: privacy in this model is not enforced by the representation.

Version 0.16.0 adds two-channel empathy (claims (l)-(liii), 1 of 4 pass): concern vs distress as two convergence targets on the resonance population at sigma = 0.25; only the high-dose distress withdrawal passes on every seed (claim (lii)), while concern alone first dilutes f on held-out seed 1234 (claim (l) FAILS), the distress count rebounds to 23 at d = 1 on that seed (claim (li) FAILS), and the channels are near-interchangeable in f there (swap difference 0.0504; claim (liii) FAILS) — no (c, d) point carries both f >= f* = 0.7278 and count <= 15 on any seed.

Version 0.17.0 adds connectome-harmonic structure-function coupling (claims (liv)-(lvi), 0 of 3 pass): the graph Laplacian from the thought-pair coupling matrix W_ij = R_ij, Bhattacharyya functional connectivity, coupling kappa(sigma) as the Pearson correlation between W and F, and the Rayleigh-quotient harmonic smoothness rho(D). The Luppi et al. 2023 prediction is reversed in this wiring — kappa falls, not rises, with loss of attunement on every seed (kappa(0.50) - kappa(0.25) = -0.599 / -0.430 / -0.423 / -0.203); the dip-and-recovery shape was a calibration-seed artefact (on the held-out seeds kappa falls monotonically with sigma); and the D signal is strongly structure-aligned at high sigma on the held-out seeds (rho down to 0.47), while the Laplacian identities hold exactly everywhere, the attuned field stays strongly coupled (kappa(0.25) >= 0.84), and the shuffle decoupling control is clean (null mean within 0.04 of zero, separated from kappa(0.25) by >= 0.81, f unchanged).
title: Faggin Field Bridge: attunement as spooky unity minus entropy cost, calibrated
